result.topic_en: A heavily corrected draft of an introduction to 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen', citing Jacobi in Crelle's Journal vol. 9 on applying Abel's addition theorem to integrate a system of differential equations, and stating that the sum of Abelian integrals over the roots can be expressed by algebraic functions and logarithms.
